analysis.title: Agent readiness signals
analysis.sourceNote: Measured by the public IsAgentReady scanner. It reads the signals a site publishes for agents; it does not run agent tasks.
analysis.notAVerdict: This is a measurement of published technical signals, not a verdict. IsAgentReady states that static scores do not predict whether an agent task will succeed.
analysis.fromCache: From the scanner's cache — no new crawl was needed.
analysis.blockersTitle: An agent may not be able to read this site
analysis.noIssues: No failing signals in this category.

print.hint: Opens this browser's print dialog. Choose "Save as PDF" there to keep a copy of the report.
print.title: Agent readiness report
print.scannedAtUnknown: The scanner did not report a scan time.

progress.scanning: Reading {{domain}}. The scanner says this takes 15–30 seconds.
progress.cached: The scanner already had {{domain}} — no crawl needed.

error.heading: The scan did not finish
error.invalid_target: That is not a web address the scanner can measure.
error.not_found: The scanner has no report for that site and would not start one.
error.unreachable: The scanner could not be reached from the browser. Mizpa relays it through its own server, and that relay is not answering.
error.protocol: The scanner answered with something Mizpa could not read.
error.timeout: The scan was still running when the time limit passed.
error.unknown: The scan failed for a reason Mizpa does not recognise.
error.rate_limited: The scanner allows 100 requests an hour per IP address, and this one has used them. It will answer again shortly.

replica.requestHint: Mizpa's agent writes a copy of this site into a workspace inside this tab. Nothing is published and nothing leaves your browser.
replica.runningPreview: The agent is building your replica…
replica.produced: Replica written. It is in the preview column on the right.
replica.producedHint: It lives in this tab's virtual workspace and is gone when the tab closes.

unavailable.heading: No replica was created
unavailable.unsupported: This browser cannot run the agent at all: it does not support JSPI, which is what the agent's runtime needs to start. No other fix is possible from here.
unavailable.no_session: Nobody is signed in, so there is no account to run the agent against and nothing to spend on a model response.
unavailable.gateway_unreachable: Mizpa's fx-gateway edge function did not answer. The problem is that it is not deployed — the browser never reached a function to talk to. Adding an API key would not change this; the function has to be deployed first.
unavailable.gateway_unconfigured: Mizpa's fx-gateway answered, and refused: it has no AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY set. So the function is deployed and this is not a deployment problem — it is a missing secret. Deploying it again would not change this.
unavailable.quota_exhausted: The agent's budget for your account is used up, so it cannot generate anything.
unavailable.runtime_unavailable: The agent's in-browser runtime started but could not be brought up, so no turn could be run.
unavailable.no_artifact: The agent ran and finished its turn, but it did not write index.html into the workspace. Its own words are below.
unavailable.turn_failed: The turn started and then failed before anything was written.
unavailable.nothingWritten: Nothing was written, so the preview column still says there is nothing to show.
unavailable.unknown: The replica could not be built for a reason this build does not recognise.
